input: Learn basic car maintenance like oil changes

gold.taskTitle: Learn Basic Car Maintenance Starting With Oil Changes
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn how to perform basic car maintenance tasks, beginning with oil changes.

questions.title: What is the make, model, and year of your car?
questions.description: Identifying the specific vehicle ensures all guidance, parts, and procedures are accurate for that car.

questions.title: Have you ever performed any car maintenance yourself before?
questions.description: Understanding the user's current experience level helps calibrate how basic or detailed the instructions need to be.

questions.title: Do you want to learn by watching, reading, or doing hands-on?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred learning style helps determine whether to recommend videos, manuals, or a guided practice session.

questions.title: Where will you be doing the maintenance work?
questions.description: The available workspace, such as a driveway, garage, or rented bay, affects what tools and setup are needed.

questions.title: Do you already own any tools like a jack or wrench set?
questions.description: Knowing what tools are already on hand determines what needs to be purchased or borrowed before starting.

questions.title: Beyond oil changes, which other maintenance tasks interest you?
questions.description: Understanding the full scope of desired skills, such as tire rotation or brake checks, helps build a complete learning plan.

questions.title: What is your target timeline for learning these skills?
questions.description: A deadline or preferred pace, such as within a month or casually over time, shapes how the plan is structured and prioritized.
